_meta.description: Year 4+ splinter faction raids. Lower intensity than Marshal's army but ongoing.

splinter_marauders.name: Iron Marauder Remnants
splinter_marauders.description: Scattered remnants of the Marshal's disbanded army. Poorly organized but still dangerous.

rust_remnants.name: Rust Wolf Packs
rust_remnants.description: Former Rust Wolf raiders who lost their Alpha during Year 2. Now operate as desperate scavenger packs.

rogue_automatons.name: Rogue Automatons
rogue_automatons.description: Corrupted Pre-War automatons that have reactivated from dormant bunkers. Operating on degraded, hostile programming.

raid_y4_spring.name: Desperate Scavengers
raid_y4_spring.flavor_text: A small band of Iron Marauder deserters has been spotted heading toward Coppervale. They're desperate and hungry.

raid_y4_summer.name: The Hungry Pack
raid_y4_summer.flavor_text: Rust Wolf remnants are targeting our food stores. They're fast and they know our layout from previous attacks.

raid_y4_autumn.name: Ghost in the Machine
raid_y4_autumn.flavor_text: DEJIN has detected corrupted automaton signals approaching from the south. Old War machines, running on hostile programming.

raid_y4_winter.name: Winter Desperation
raid_y4_winter.flavor_text: Winter drives the desperate to desperate measures. Marauder remnants are making a play for our supplies.

raid_y5p_spring.name: Seasonal Trouble
raid_y5p_spring.flavor_text: The threats never fully end. But Coppervale is stronger than any of them.

raid_y5p_summer.name: Summer Raiders
raid_y5p_summer.flavor_text: Another band of opportunists. Nothing Coppervale's defenses can't handle.

raid_y5p_autumn.name: Autumn Offensive
raid_y5p_autumn.flavor_text: A larger than usual raiding party. Keep the defenses sharp.

raid_y5p_winter.name: Cold Comfort
raid_y5p_winter.flavor_text: Winter raiders, cold and desperate. Defend the stores.
